extractors.broad_inline_aware: label-only sections, else `Label: text` inside a paragraph, any broad label; reads the singular `Key learning: text` that most skill-craft commits use

extractors.strict_inline_aware: label-only sections, else `Label: text` inside a paragraph, strict labels only (the form many real improve-commit messages use)
